digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherit unconstrained 16,000-token, three-structured-attempt, and 600-second budgets, allowing multiple long generations before advisory abstention when responses are malformed or runaway.

The judge_batch RunRequest declares no operation-local output, structured-retry, transport-attempt, or timeout bounds, violating documented intent in story 9022 and ADR 0086 for a bounded advisory classifier with prompt degradation to abstention.

Malformed candidate_id echo responses triggered repeated structured-output retries with 16,000-token caps and multi-minute elapsed times (216–311 seconds observed), consuming excessive latency before safe abstention.

Applied repair introduces lowering-only RunRequest seams for output-token limit, structured-retry count, transport-attempt count, and request timeout, with overlap-judge receiving explicit 1,024-token, one-attempt, one-transport, 60-second budgets.
Valid six-candidate verdicts and label-keyed aggregation behavior are preserved byte-for-byte; callers omitting request-local limits retain existing defaults.
